ayahOccurrences.text: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُۥ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ قَالَ مَآ أَظُنُّ أَن تَبِيدَ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُۥ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ قَالَ مَآ أَظُنُّ أَن تَبِيدَ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person feminine singular imperfect verb, subjunctive mood
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تَبِيدَ is in the derivative form: تَبِيدُ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ب/ي/د b–y–d desert; to vanish, to be cut off; to perish, to become extinct. Of this root, تَبِيدُ tabıd occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَبِيدُ tabıd [imperf. of v. بَادَ bāda, intrans.] to perish, to become extinct

(18:35) مَا أَظُنُّ أَنْ تَبِيدَ هَذِهِ أَبَدًا I do not think that this will ever perish.
